generator.params.note: Hand-set from general knowledge of the species: a large pine with an open, rounded crown, stout branches and long needles in bundles of three, tufted at the twig ends. Not fitted to measurements.

allometry.note: Rough sizes from general knowledge of the species: 24 m tall and 50 cm across at breast height at 60 years in the open. Replace with measured data before calling this species calibrated.

appearance.note: Colours chosen by eye: yellow-green needles; orange-brown bark in large plates.
